svg.title: Wideband buffer playback and Raw IQ streaming

cc:Work.dc:title: Wideband buffer playback and Raw IQ streaming
cc:Work.dc:description: The same faster-varying waveform repeats with buffer playback. In Raw IQ streaming, the slower host waveform changes as the next blocks arrive. Playback and host input rates are labeled separately.
